data.long_meaning: One who is loved by Allah, a name given to Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and Prophet Luqman in the Quran. The name Beleel carries the meaning “Divine, God's Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Beleel usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, god's beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Beleel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine, God's Beloved.”

in_arabic.name: بيلعل
in_arabic.meaning: أسم مشتق من الجذر الباء الواو العين، يعني الشخص الذي يؤمن بالله من قلبه
in_arabic.long_meaning: البيلعل: الشخص الذي يؤمن بالله من قلبه، ويتبع طريقه دون أن يحتاج إلى توجيه أو إثارة، هذا هو معنى اسم بيلعل الذي ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحاقة آية 25، حيث يقول الله تعالى: { وَإِن تُبِدوا وَتُفْسِدُوا فَلِلَّهِ ما تُفْسِدُونَ وَيَسْتُرُ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَإِن يَسْتَغْفِرِ الطَّاغُوتُ وَمَن تَدَعُ اللَّهُ يَستَغْفِرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ }، ويوصف الشخص الذي يؤمن بالله من قلبه بالبيلعل، ويتميز بصدقه وثقافته، وهو الشخص الذي يتبع طريقه دون أن يحتاج إلى توجيه أو إثارة، والاسم مشتق من الجذر الباء الواو العين، والذي يعود إلى الجذر الأصلي الباء الواو العين، ويوجد له عدة معان أخرى، مثل الخصب والبركة، ولكن في هذا السياق، يعني الإيمان بالله من قلبه.

in_english.name: Beleel
in_english.meaning: This name means a person who believes in God from his heart
in_english.long_meaning: The name Beleel is derived from the root letter Ba, Waw, and Ain, which means a person who believes in God from his heart, and follows His path without any guidance or incitement. This name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Haqqa, verse 25, where Allah says: { وَإِن تُبِدوا وَتُفْسِدُوا فَلِلَّهِ ما تُفْسِدُونَ وَيَسْتُرُ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَإِن يَسْتَغْفِرِ الطَّاغُوتُ وَمَن تَدَعُ اللَهَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ إِنَّ اللَهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ }, where the person who believes in God from his heart is described as Beleel, and is characterized by his sincerity and culture. The name Beleel is suitable for a person who believes in God from his heart, and follows His path without any guidance or incitement.

data.cultural_impact: The name Beleel is of Arabic origin, and it holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world as it is mentioned in the Holy Quran. It is a name given to two prophets mentioned in the Quran, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and Prophet Luqman. Prophet Ibrahim is considered the "model" or "the father of all prophets," and his devotion to Allah and His message has been an inspiration for millions of Muslims throughout history. Prophet Luqman, known for his wisdom and piety, is often referred to in the Quran as a "man of great understanding" and a "man of pure belief."
data.spiritual_significance: The name Beleel holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims as it is a reminder that true love, devotion, and obedience belong to Allah alone. By acknowledging and embracing this name, one is connecting with the spirit of the Prophets Ibrahim and Luqman, who devoted their lives to seeking knowledge, worshiping Allah, and spreading His message of unity and peace. This name signifies being loved by Allah, and striving to live a life in accordance with His commandments, and to always remember and serve Him, as it reflects in the Hadith, "Whomsoever Allah loves, Allah makes hisheart esteem the remembrance of Allah, and his wealth and children a source of barakah (blessing) for him." (Bukhari)
